scripts.check:contracts: npm run check:version && npm run check:seed-catalog && npm run check:tauri-invokes && npm run check:companion-routes && npm run check:ui-orphans && npm run check:ui-architecture
scripts.test:rust: npm run fmt:rust && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.smoke: npm --prefix ./ui run build && npm run lint:ui && npm run test:companion && npm run test:ui && npm run check:contracts && npm run doctor

scripts.scrape:safe: npm run doctor && npm run scrape
scripts.scrape:auto:safe: npm run doctor && npm run scrape:auto
